parole.significato: A soldier (or war veteran) of the Swedish kings Charles XI and Charles XII.
parole.testo: Calque of Swedish karolin, ultimately derived from Latin Carolus (“Charles”).

parole.significato: Relating to the metric temperature scale of said name.
parole.testo: Named after Swedish astronomer Anders Celsius (1701–1744), who first proposed the centigrade scale in 1742. The surname is Latinized from the estate's name, Latin celsus (“mound”).

parole.significato: A pastry with a cream and almond paste filling, traditionally eaten on Shrove Tuesday in Sweden, Finland and Estonia.
parole.testo: From Swedish semla, ultimately from Latin simila (“finest quality wheat flour”), through Old Swedish. Doublet of semola and semel; compare semolina.

parole.significato: A motor car manufactured by Volvo.
parole.testo: From Swedish Volvo, from Latin volvō (“to roll”), in reference to ball bearings which were the company's original product.
